Read an SBML document

Source: R/read.R
sbml_read.Rd

Reads an SBML Level 3 core document into an sbml_model. Every element carries the attributes the specification defines for the document's level and version; optional values without a Level 3 default read as NA.

Usage

sbml_read(x, ignore_packages = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A file path, a file://, http:// or https:// URL, a string holding the XML itself, or a raw vector.

ignore_packages

A document that uses SBML Level 3 packages (comp, fbc, ...) is refused with a zusbml_unsupported error naming them. With TRUE, the core model is read, the package content is dropped, and the dropped package names are kept in the model's ignored_packages.

Value

An sbml_model.

Errors

  • zusbml_parse_error for a malformed document: an unknown element or attribute in the SBML namespace, a missing required attribute, or a value of the wrong type. Its path field names the element, for example model/listOfSpecies/species[3], and attribute the attribute.

  • zusbml_unsupported for SBML packages and for levels other than 3.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml")
m <- sbml_read(path)
m
#> <sbml_model 'decay'> SBML Level 3 Version 2
#>   compartments  1
#>   species       2
#>   parameters    1
#>   reactions     1
sbml_species(m)
#>   id name compartment initial_amount initial_concentration substance_units
#> 1 S1 <NA>           C              1                    NA            <NA>
#> 2 S2 <NA>           C              0                    NA            <NA>
#>   has_only_substance_units boundary_condition constant conversion_factor metaid
#> 1                    FALSE              FALSE    FALSE              <NA>   <NA>
#> 2                    FALSE              FALSE    FALSE              <NA>   <NA>
#>   sbo_term notes annotation
#> 1     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>
#> 2     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>
